# Component Demo

A test notebook that exercises **every interactive component**, one per page, so you can rapidly check rendering and behaviour in the preview (`./ui.sh notes`). Page-turn buttons move between pages.

## Text & markdown
Text blocks render markdown: *italic*, **bold**, `code`, and lists:

- first item
- second item
- third item

Drag the stylus or a finger across this paragraph to test **highlighting**; hold on a highlight for the **sticky-note** menu.

## Image block

Images load from the notebook's own assets via the bridge. Below: `fit: contain` with a caption, then `fit: cover`.

blocks.caption: An image block (fit: contain) with a caption.

blocks.md:
## MCQ blocks

Tap a choice, then **Check** to grade + reveal the explanation. First is single-answer, second is multi-answer.

blocks.prompt: Which of these is a primary colour?
blocks.explain: Red is a primary colour; green and orange are mixed.
2 and 4 are even; 3 and 5 are odd.

blocks.md:
## Sketch box (drawing block)

The daemon ink box auto-attaches over the box below so you can draw in it while the page text stays visible. On the device this is real low-latency ink; in the browser preview the box renders but inking needs the device.

## Animation block

Pure web SVG/CSS; on the device native fast-refreshes just this region. Press **Play**. (Remember: active animation and active writing can't run at the same time on the panel.)

## Hotspots (labeled diagram)

An image with tappable numbered markers. Tap a marker to reveal its note in the panel below — reveal is ephemeral (no save). Coords are normalized 0..1 of the image.

blocks.caption: Tap a marker to reveal its note.

blocks.md:
## Callouts
Four variants, mono-safe: outline weight + tag, no grey fills.

blocks.title: Remember
blocks.md: A **note** callout: the default variant, for asides and context.

A *tip* callout uses a dashed outline. Great for study hints:
- skim first
- then read deeply

blocks.title: Common mistake
blocks.md: A **warning** callout gets a heavier outline. Don't confuse velocity with speed.

blocks.title: Seneca
blocks.md: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.

## Math
Display equations render offline with KaTeX. Malformed TeX falls back to raw text (dashed box), never lost.

## Flashcards
Tap a card to flip it. The flip is a class swap (partial refresh) and re-flows the page.

blocks.back:
**F = ma**

Force equals mass times acceleration. The longer back face also tests the flip re-pagination.

blocks.md:
## Checklist
Tap a row to check it. **Checked state persists** (saved into the notebook, like MCQ answers) — reload to confirm.

## Cloze
Tap a blank to reveal the hidden word; tap again to hide it. Reveal is ephemeral (not saved).

The capital of France is {{Paris}}, and the capital of Ireland is {{Dublin}}.

Water is made of {{hydrogen}} and {{oxygen}}. At sea level it boils at {{100}} °C.
